lessons.title: Juve’s first colors and ground
lessons.subtitle: From pink shirts to the Parade Ground

story.title: A schoolboy idea
story.body: A group of Turin schoolboys created Juventus in 1897. Its first home ground was Piazza d’Armi, and its first shirts were pink.

story.title: A change in identity
story.body: The club moved from pink to black and white in 1903; the Juventus history says those colors came from Nottingham.

facts.evidence: The club history says Juventus started out wearing pink.

facts.scope: The club history dates the adoption of the Bianconeri colors to three years after 1900.
facts.evidence: Juventus states that the black-and-white colors were in use three years after its 1900 national-championship debut.
